## Document Version History  
| Version | Date | Change | Author |
|---------|------|--------|--------|
| 1.0 | 2026-01-15 | Initial complaint resolution guide | Head of Customer Service |  
---  
**We're Here to Help!**  
Your satisfaction is our priority. If something goes wrong, we want to fix it. Don't hesitate to complain — your feedback helps us improve.

raw_entities.name: Complaint Resolution Process
raw_entities.description: A customer-facing complaint resolution procedure designed to address customer dissatisfaction and service failures. The process prioritizes customer satisfaction and uses feedback to drive continuous improvement. This is the overarching operational framework for handling and resolving customer complaints.
context: Your satisfaction is our priority. If something goes wrong, we want to fix it.
Don't hesitate to complain — your feedback helps us improve.

raw_entities.name: Head of Customer Service
raw_entities.description: The senior leadership role responsible for authoring and maintaining the complaint resolution guide. This role has authority over customer service operations and policy documentation.

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: The individual customer who may experience service failures or dissatisfaction and is encouraged to submit complaints. The process is designed to address their concerns and resolve issues to restore satisfaction.
